callrenard.purpose: Collect caller responses and prepare a summary for the person following up.
capabilities: Disclose the automated assistant and request recording consent
Collect keypad responses to a configured sequence of questions
Format the captured answers for follow-up
callrenard.limitations: The example demonstrates the summary formatter. A live call, message delivery and customer integration require a separate demonstration. Contact Vriksh to arrange a demonstration.
callrenard.evidence: backend/app/services/call_flow.py and backend/tests/test_call_flow.py; public artifact is formatter output
